nodes.label: CI Workflow
nodes.rationale: Matrix-tests Python 3.11/3.12/3.13, runs ruff lint+format and pytest under xvfb, then a mock-pipeline benchmark that fails the build on a budget breach.

nodes.label: Six-layer event-bus pipeline
nodes.rationale: No module calls another directly — all communication goes through the orchestrator and a central pub/sub bus. Decouples stages so each can be tested and replaced independently.

nodes.label: Model-agnostic provider plug-in system
nodes.rationale: ASR, cleanup, insertion, and vision are interface-based adapters registered by name; users swap any provider with a one-line config change. Keeps the app out of the model-wars.

nodes.label: Local-first principle
nodes.rationale: Default stack (faster-whisper + rules cleanup) runs fully offline with no data leaving the machine. Network use is opt-in per feature (LLM cleanup, vision).

nodes.label: ProviderRegistry
nodes.rationale: Maps provider names from config to concrete classes; instantiated at startup. Centralized factory keeps the wire-up out of feature code.

nodes.label: OpenAI-compatible vision provider (v3)
nodes.rationale: Single built-in vision provider that reuses the OpenAI-compatible chat-completions adapter so any cloud or self-hosted vision endpoint works without per-vendor code.

nodes.label: Screenshot-to-Text (v3)
nodes.rationale: Snip mid-dictation -> VLM extract -> splice at spoken anchor phrase. Cheaper than pasting images downstream and lands as editable text at the cursor.

nodes.label: Anchor-based splicing
nodes.rationale: Spoken phrases like 'as in the attached screenshot' are replaced by the extracted markdown/text in capture order; leftover appends at end. Spoken words also act as the extraction instruction.

nodes.label: Live streaming ASR (v2)
nodes.rationale: Fast streaming model emits partials; the accurate model still produces the final inserted text. Partials are throwaway previews, so quality/roughness trade-off is acceptable.

nodes.label: Per-app context engine (v2)
nodes.rationale: Glob-match the active app to a cleanup style. Advisory only — never blocks dictation on context failure; falls back to the global cleanup.style.

nodes.label: Voice editing commands (v2)
nodes.rationale: High-precision phrases recognized only at the start of an utterance. Precision over recall — any mid-phrase 'new line' is typed normally rather than swallowed.

nodes.label: Adaptive vocabulary learning (v2)
nodes.rationale: Undo + re-dictate the same correction `promote_threshold` times locks the mapping into the live vocabulary. Reuses the deterministic vocabulary substitution path — no ML.

nodes.label: Interactive setup wizard (v0.3.5)
nodes.rationale: Replaces manual YAML editing; auto-opens every launch with a toggle to disable. Walks every config block in five minutes.

nodes.label: Tabbed Settings window (v0.3.5)
nodes.rationale: Day-to-day tweaks live in a tabbed UI; a banner surfaces every field that needs a relaunch.

nodes.label: Lenient config loader (v0.3.5)
nodes.rationale: Loads broken configs with warnings rather than crashing; preserves user input and opens the wizard to fix issues before pipeline init.

nodes.label: WAV conversion for OpenAI ASR (v0.3.5)
nodes.rationale: Raw float32 PCM fails Whisper-compatible endpoints with HTTP 400; wrap in RIFF/WAVE before upload.

nodes.label: Dedicated VAD worker thread (v0.3.6 R2)
nodes.rationale: Move silero inference off the real-time audio callback so the sounddevice callback stays under 5 ms p99; callback only enqueues a tuple and reads a cached bool.

nodes.label: Persistent httpx.AsyncClient (v0.3.6 R8)
nodes.rationale: Cleanup and vision providers reuse one async client across dictations instead of reconnecting per call. warm_up() and shutdown() now route through the shared client.

nodes.label: Parallel multi-screenshot vision extraction (v0.3.6 R10)
nodes.rationale: asyncio.gather preserves screenshot order while avoiding serial VLM round trips; per-shot error isolation so one failure doesn't kill the batch.

nodes.label: Serialized OS input executor (v0.3.6 R11)
nodes.rationale: Single worker executor for pyautogui/pyperclip prevents interleaving during insert/undo races.

nodes.label: O(1) vocab casing lookup (v0.3.6 R12)
nodes.rationale: Sidecar lowercase-lookup dict alongside the compiled regex — avoid linear scans to find correct casing.

nodes.label: Bulk adaptive vocab promotion (v0.3.6 R13)
nodes.rationale: Promote many learned mappings at once so the compiled regex rebuilds once per merge, not once per mapping.

nodes.label: Lazy built-in provider imports (v0.3.6 R14)
nodes.rationale: Register providers as module:Class dotted paths, resolved on first use — cloud-only users avoid ctranslate2 cold-start.

nodes.label: Custom cleanup prompt mtime cache (v0.3.6 R9)
nodes.rationale: Cache custom_prompt_path contents keyed by file mtime to remove synchronous disk reads from every rewrite.
nodes.norm_label: custom cleanup prompt mtime cache (v0.3.6 r9)

nodes.label: Pipeline benchmark harness
nodes.rationale: Two modes: mock (CI-gated orchestration budgets, enforced, exits non-zero on breach) and real (reports only over WAV fixtures). Mock budgets live in MOCK_BUDGETS_MS — change only with deliberate reason.

nodes.label: api_key_env indirection
nodes.rationale: Config holds the env var NAME, not the key — secrets never written to disk. App reads the variable at runtime; missing variable is replaced with an empty string.

nodes.label: Domain-error wrapping pattern
nodes.rationale: Providers raise ASRError / CleanupError from utils/errors.py — no raw exceptions propagate from a provider method. Keeps orchestrator error handling uniform across providers.

nodes.label: Undo-last-insertion hotkey (v2)
nodes.rationale: ctrl+shift+z re-focuses the target window and removes exactly the typed characters — no clipboard needed, works even if focus has switched to logs.

nodes.label: Cleanup style modes
nodes.rationale: raw, light, standard, technical, professional, custom — each with progressively more text-rewriting. technical protects code identifiers; custom swaps in a user-supplied prompt.

nodes.label: Provider warm-up at startup
nodes.rationale: Preload ASR model and prime HTTP pools after the tray appears so the first dictation has no cold-start penalty. Runs in the background; never blocks startup.

nodes.label: CUDA -> CPU fallback
nodes.rationale: faster-whisper auto-probes CUDA; on probe failure it falls back to CPU and logs a one-time warning. Users can force CPU via asr.extra.device: cpu to skip the probe.

nodes.label: Silero VAD
nodes.rationale: Pre-trained voice activity detector downloaded from Hugging Face on first run (~5 MB). Provides near-zero-cost silence detection so the audio callback stays cheap.

nodes.label: TimingEvent on event bus
nodes.rationale: Per-stage timing emitted on the event bus for every dictation cycle, written to ~/.agentvoca/agentvoca.log. Surfaces which stage is slow before users start guessing.
